title: Build and run an experiment backlog
summary: Growth comes from many small, well-chosen tests. Keep a ranked backlog of experiments and run them steadily.

beginner: Collect ideas for the priority funnel stage.
Write each as a hypothesis with an expected result.
Rank them by expected impact, confidence and effort.
Run the top ones, one change at a time.
Record every result and what you learned.
intermediate: Run experiments at a steady pace.
experienced: Track experiment velocity and win rate.
Combine learning into bigger product bets.

toolExamples.notion: Keep an experiment backlog with hypothesis, score, status and result.

pitfalls: Testing tiny changes with no real impact
